name: Taka Jewellery Holdings Limited
summary: Taka Jewellery Holdings Limited, a Singapore-based investment holding company founded in 1997, is involved in the complete cycle of jewelry, from conceptual design and manufacturing to wholesale distribution and retail sales. Its international presence spans Singapore, the United States, Europe, various parts of Asia, Africa, and Australia. The company organizes its business into three primary divisions: Exhibitions, Retail, and Financial Services. Beyond new pieces, it also trades and retails pre-owned jewelry under its 'Top Cash' brand. Its operations are further diversified to include the sale of secondhand jewelry, offering secured lending and pawnbroking services, and functioning as a broker and trader for gold bullion. The company manages jewelry retail outlets under its flagship 'Taka Jewellery' brand, operates numerous pawnshops, and markets a modern jewelry collection through its 'Voi' brand. This entity was previously known as TLV Holdings Limited.
